notes.en:
## New Features

- Redesign the dashboard around a single composer: choose a working directory and model, then send a task to create a session and use it as the first message, with slash commands, skills, image and file paste, input history and a browser-local draft.
- Group sessions as cards that need you, running and recent, and show each session's latest tool calls as one-line summaries over a new bounded activity subscription.
- Display plan quotas as Codex-style vertical bars for every limit window (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the narrator status bar and the model picker, with shared progress panels for OpenCode Go, Kimi and Command Code.
- Suspend OpenCode Go sessions until the known quota reset and replay them automatically, distinguishing quota walls, throttles and billing walls instead of failing or burning retry budgets.
- Discover balance support for sub2api and new-api connections automatically, separating wallet, key and subscription quotas.
- Close subagent recovery cards to leave those subagents stopped.

## Improvements

- Store model catalog metadata in one raw format end to end, so what settings.json holds, memory keeps, editors patch and the resolver merges is the same shape; a reload no longer drops provider-page context windows or model-card edits.
- Set a context window for one provider entry or model-wide, with provider entry > model-wide > preset precedence and a scope switch in the catalog; stored window maps and legacy bindings migrate automatically.
- Derive DeepSeek reasoning tiers from the model catalog instead of hiding them or promoting xhigh to max through UI overrides.
- Mirror helper and executor binaries through update mirrors with bounded parallel transfers, cancellation, disk accounting and configurable deadlines.
- Count a request's own main-thread blocking in diagnostics, and keep later short requests out of lag candidates.
- Wait for the previous process to release the instance lock and retry once, and stop handoff environment from leaking into later child processes.

## Fixes

- Open slash-command, mention and command-parameter popovers below the composer when there is insufficient space above, preventing dashboard menus from being clipped off-screen.
- Fix file-change cards for chapter and project subagents by resolving their parent workspace, and bind background Agent runs to their parent call receipt.
- Let explore and plan subagents run approved Bash commands under the inherited permission mode again instead of failing the read-only capability ceiling.
- Keep escaped `[image #` and `[file #` text from stealing attachments, and align rebuilt Anthropic history image order with the original request so prompt caching stays effective.
- Open the directory browser at the nearest existing parent for a missing initial path, and format context windows through the shared intl formatter.
- Draw dashboard tool-row marks without importing the virtual list module.

## Upgrade Notes

- Published to the beta / prerelease channel. Requires executor-v0.9.4; helpers-v1.0.0 is unchanged.
- No database migration. The model catalog moves to a single raw format; existing settings and cached snapshots are imported when read, and old context-window maps become per-provider-entry windows with a catalog backup taken first.
- Reload any settings page loaded before the upgrade before saving provider settings; a stale page's context-window field is rejected with a reload hint.
- Older builds reject the new catalog `connections` field, so keep a settings backup if you may downgrade.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 工作台改为单一输入框：选定工作目录与模型后直接发送任务，即创建会话并把内容作为第一条消息，支持斜杠命令、技能、图片与文件粘贴、输入历史和浏览器本地草稿。
- 会话以卡片分组为待你处理、运行中与最近使用，并在新的有界活动订阅上以单行摘要显示每个会话最近的工具调用。
- 叙述者状态栏与模型选择器把套餐额度显示为 Codex 式竖条，覆盖每个限额窗口（5 小时 / 周 / 月）；OpenCode Go、Kimi 与 Command Code 共用同一进度条面板。
- OpenCode Go 额度耗尽时按已知重置时刻挂起会话并自动重放，区分配额墙、限流与计费墙，不再直接失败或耗尽重试预算。
- 自动探测 sub2api 与 new-api 连接的余额支持，区分钱包、Key 与订阅额度。
- 子代理恢复卡片可以关闭，让这些子代理保持停止。

## 改进

- 模型目录元数据全链路统一为单一原始格式：settings.json 存储、内存持有、编辑器修改与解析合并使用同一形态，重新加载不再丢失提供商页上下文窗口或模型卡片编辑。
- 上下文窗口可按单个提供商条目或整个模型设置，优先级为提供商条目 > 模型级 > 预设，目录中提供作用域切换；已存储的窗口映射与旧绑定自动迁移。
- DeepSeek 推理档位改为从模型目录推导，不再通过界面覆盖隐藏低档或把 xhigh 提升为 max。
- 辅助工具与 executor 二进制可通过更新镜像交付，支持有界并行传输、取消、磁盘计数与可配置截止时间。
- 诊断记录请求自身对主线程的阻塞，滞后日志不再把阻塞结束后的短请求列为候选。
- 实例锁冲突时等待旧进程退出并重试一次，交接环境不再残留给后续子进程。

## 修复

- 输入框上方空间不足时，斜杠命令、提及与命令参数弹窗自动向下展开，避免工作台菜单被裁出屏幕。
- 修复章节与项目子代理的文件变更卡片：按父工作区解析，并把后台 Agent 运行绑定到其父调用回执。
- explore 与 plan 子代理在继承的权限模式下可再次执行已批准的 Bash 命令，不再因只读能力上限失败。
- 转义的 `[image #`、`[file #` 文字不再抢走附件；Anthropic 历史重建的图片顺序与原始请求一致，提示缓存保持有效。
- 初始路径不存在时，目录浏览器打开最近的已存在父目录；上下文窗口统一通过共享的 intl 格式化。
- 工作台工具行标记改为本地绘制，不再静态导入虚拟列表模块。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，依赖 executor-v0.9.4；helpers-v1.0.0 保持不变。
- 本次无数据库迁移。模型目录改为单一原始格式，既有设置与缓存快照在读取时导入，旧的上下文窗口映射转为按提供商条目的窗口，转换前会先备份目录。
- 升级前已打开的设置页请刷新后再保存提供商设置，旧页面的上下文窗口字段会被拒绝并提示重新加载。
- 旧版本不接受新的目录 `connections` 字段，如需回退请保留设置备份。
